events.title: Beaujolais Day
events.description:
Reindeer & friends invite you to join us for A Very British Beaujolais Day - a long lunch bringing everyone together for an Anglo-French feast, Beaujolais, live music, entertainment & great company.

Expect Cheddar & ale onion soup with English black winter truffle, followed by roast Staffordshire beef with clotted cream pomme purée, honey-glazed carrots, winter vegetables & Beaujolais jus - or a wild mushroom pithivier for our vegetarian guests.

To finish, enjoy a selection of cheeses from both sides of the Channel, alongside plenty of Beaujolais for the table.

There’ll also be live music, entertainment and raffle prizes.

Thursday 19 November, from 12 noon | £69pp

In support of Maggie’s at City Hospital, with every ticket helping to support people with cancer and their families.

Everyone is welcome - bring your friends, come hungry and raise a glass! 🍷

Tables available for 2–8 people, with singles very welcome too.

Tickets are limited, so get your table together and join us for Beaujolais Day at The Reindeer.
